unit: bytes (gzip for the js and css entries; the codemod entries are the installed size of the files named, no compression; tarballs: npm pack --dry-run --json unpackedSize and size, in bytes)

modern-cmdk@1.4.note: not on npm; built from release/1.4.0 in a throwaway worktree (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts, pnpm --filter modern-cmdk run build); the manifest still reads 1.2.3 because changesets versions at publish; no THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and no dist/codemod/bin.mjs shim in 1.4

modern-cmdk@1.5-rc.note: the manifest still reads 1.2.3 (changesets versions at publish); runtimeUnpackedSize = unpackedSize minus every file under dist/codemod/ (the shim bin.mjs is in the codemod part); THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md is in the runtime part and listed separately

modern-cmdk-codemod@1.5-rc.note: manifest version 0.0.0 until the first changeset versions it to 1.0.0; jscodeshift and its dependencies are not in the tarball

create-modern-cmdk@1.5-rc.note: the manifest still reads 1.2.2 (changesets versions at publish)

measuredWith.pack: npm pack --dry-run --json, run in packages/modern-cmdk, packages/modern-cmdk-codemod and packages/create-modern-cmdk on the committed release candidate tree after a fresh pnpm build (npm 12.1.0, the npm bundled with the pinned Node, prints an object keyed by package name); the modern-cmdk@1.4 block was measured in the release/1.4.0 worktree described under worktree14
measuredWith.codemodPart: the sum of the sizes of the files under dist/codemod/ in the modern-cmdk pack listing; runtime = unpackedSize minus that sum
measuredWith.sizeLimit: pnpm build (a fresh build of every package), then pnpm exec size-limit --json (reads the size-limit config of the root package.json)
measuredWith.worktree14: git worktree add <scratchpad>/probe-W6-01 release/1.4.0; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts; pnpm --filter modern-cmdk run build; removed afterwards (rm -rf, git worktree prune)
